profile.name: Marius Minia
profile.headline: IT instructor and software development trainer
profile.summary: Experienced in corporate academies, vocational courses and technical training programmes for junior developers, students and professionals. Teaching combines hands-on exercises, project work, code reviews, guided debugging and progressive skill-building.
profile.description: I teach Full-Stack programming, web development, databases, software quality, Agile methodologies, UX/UI design and digital tools. My practical approach combines hands-on exercises, project work, code reviews, guided debugging and progressive skill-building. My strength lies in combining technical expertise, clear instruction and a strong design sensibility. I go beyond syntax and frameworks, helping learners think like developers: analyse problems, structure solutions, write maintainable code and present projects professionally.

educationAndCertifications.title: Diploma in Accounting and Programming
educationAndCertifications.description: In addition to the standard curriculum of a Technical Commercial Institute, I was introduced to Java and Visual Basic. The accounting programme also incorporated modern tools such as the Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel, alongside traditional double-entry bookkeeping. I graduated with a score of 95/100.
